searchStrategy.rule: Preserve the same six-affix architecture first; relax numeric thresholds before adding another normal affix that cannot coexist.

currentFallback.structure: Keep Life + Lightning + Deflection + Mana Leech. Require at least one of Physical or Cold attack damage, then rank high-end results for Rune/Bonded/roll compensation.

currentTarget.note: Preserve exact current 3P+3S architecture by post-filtering the collected listings rather than inventing an unavailable Trade stat.

buildContext.note: Removing current Ring 1 also removes Sapphire implicit +30 Cold and +41 explicit Cold. Cold has large overcap, so Cold Resistance is not a first-pass hard filter. Mana Regen is a sustain preference and must be checked on shortlisted replacements.

firstSearch.note: Do not over-tighten Life before protecting offense. Damage mins are anchored to the current ring's low-end rolls (11-17 phys, 23-37 cold). Final candidates must still be post-checked against both endpoints/overall damage before recommendation.

ranking: do not reduce current ring attack contribution (11-17 Physical and 23-37 Cold baseline)
prefer Life materially above current 83 without using Life as the main choke point
do not create unsafe mana sustain
